overviewHtml:
Teams want AI analysis inside their automations without leaving Dynatrace. This connector brings Claude into Workflows as an action.

What you get

  • Managed connections to Claude with support for different models, using an API key
  • Prompt defined and executed directly in the workflow action
  • Response stored and analyzed in Dynatrace
  • Example workflow that queries logs and asks Claude for error analysis
setupHtml:
Claude Connector for Dynatrace Workflows is available as a Dynatrace app to all customers upon request.

  1. Claude Connector for Dynatrace Workflows is delivered via a Hub subscription. Email community-apps@dynatrace.com with your account name and tenant ID, as described here.
  2. We'll process your request and send instructions for subscribing to the channel and installing the app.
  3. After installation, search for Claude in Workflows to find it as a new action.
getStartedHtml:
1. Request the Hub subscription by emailing the community apps team
  2. Install the app from Hub
  3. Add the Claude action to a workflow and create a connection
